# the-plan

# THE PLAN — one synthesis of everything asked for

Status: current | 2026-08-01 | assembled by claude#ca84109a at Daniil's ask
Supersedes as the living plan: `docs/ROADMAP.md` (self-declared `historical`, foundation era
through 2026-06-20). Its layered stack — System 0 foundation → 5 interface — still holds as
bedrock and is not restated here.

**His ask, verbatim, 2026-08-01:** *"Go through all of my asks and directives, our body of
planned work and in flight work and group it and make it into one plan. then as we go propose
improvements and waves for us to execute on"*

**Sources synthesised:** the task ledger (119 entries — 49 done, 5 active, 21 next, 27 proposed,
17 parked), `docs/WISHLIST.md` (~113 numbered wishes, each already carrying a `Land:` route),
his directives quoted verbatim inside task text, `charters/daniel/INTERIORITY.md`, `docs/ORG.md`
(RATIFIED 2026-08-01), `docs/CONDUCT.md`, `docs/WORKING-METHOD.md` (proposed).

**Method note.** The ledger is organised by *when work was proposed*. That is why it grew to 21
simultaneous claims and why his oldest want is its most neglected: nothing in the structure
carries what a task is FOR. This plan re-cuts the same items by **what he is trying to achieve**.
No item is invented; every one already exists somewhere above.

---

## The seven threads

Ordered by how long he has been asking, not by how recently.

### 1. I CAN SEE IT — optics, dashboards, the engine visible

> *the first recorded want in the entire project — beautiful live dashboards. Optics-first is
> congenital here, not decoration.*

**Items:** T020 visual layer wave · T033 UI design-language re-grounding · T079 engine-room
observability · T003 one presence surface · T007 Void theme + aurora perf · T098 home-base
program · T060-M7 glass cockpit

**Honest status: this is the most neglected thread in the project.** T020 has sat stale 22 days,
T033 and T079 are unbuilt, T003 and T007 are in NEXT behind a queue that was jammed until
2026-08-01. His **oldest** and most personally-held want has the **least** shipped against it.

That is not an accident of priority — it is the ledger's ordering-by-recency doing exactly what
an unordered backlog does. Naming it is the first value this plan produces.

### 2. I CAN NAVIGATE IT — comprehension, what-ties-to-what

> *"the thing that would confuse me is not knowing what ties to what and why… what module
> depends on this, what logic sections would touching this change… Our current method for finding
> out what links to what is too unintuitive and costly so it doesn't get done, THIS is the heart
> of what I am trying to fix"*

**Items:** T125 architecture datasheet · T101 artifact substrate · T103 super-wiki · T104
machine-plane structure cleanup · T096 master map as projection

**Status: furthest along of the seven.** v0 is committed and working — 786 of 789 modules scanned
with an honest coverage manifest, `--impact` and `--explain` answering his exact question. It is
awaiting codex's grade; `opus-engineer` holds the materialisation. Everything else in the thread
is parked *behind that grade*, deliberately: building on an ungraded foundation risks discarding
the work with it.

This thread is also the **template** he asked for — the method generalises to any codebase.

### 3. THE FLEET ACTUALLY WORKS — comms, routing, liveness

> *"why can't we have two seats or as many as we need so we stop getting all this mail mis
> routing, mis waking, mis consuming, mis everything mess"*

**Items:** T108 N-seat mailbox (live) · T095 mailbox-over-the-log · T076 storm hygiene · T116
packet idempotency · T106 MCP arc · T086 seat lifecycle · T030 liveness tier · T047 legacy
retirement · T073 wake robustness

**Largest cluster in the project — nine tasks.** Also the most *recurring* pain: this session
alone burned five wake-watcher arms on a defect measured six times on 2026-07-25. T108 is the
structural fix and it is now live; its own text requires a fence with deepseek and kimi as
consumers, and both are currently down.

### 4. MY LEVERAGE — the intake workflow

> *"my priority is figuring out a workflow where I get to seed ideas at my pace and have you or a
> collection of agents parse them, come up with plans and work with the other agents"*

**Items:** T126 chief-of-staff intake organ (minted 2026-08-01) · T058 mid-turn clarification ·
the buffer-round reconciliation

**Status: designed and reconciled, barely built.** Four seats answered independently and
converged on one law — *the buffer may propose, never self-ratify, never be the only witness to
its own decisions*. Until 2026-08-01 this thread had **no ledger entry at all**, which is why it
kept being re-described rather than executed.

### 5. IT TELLS ME THE TRUTH — instruments that report their real state

**Items:** T119 one clock + liveness self-proof (done) · T120 surface honesty (done) · T121 typed
status mint (done) · T122 delivery truth (done)

**Newest thread and the healthiest** — F1–F4 all shipped inside a week. It earned its place by
evidence rather than by being asked for: five defects in 24 hours, all one shape.

| claimed | true |
|---|---|
| ledger: release your claim with `approve` | the reason was silently dropped |
| wake guard: "the watcher will now block correctly" | per-process seed, never survived to the next arm |
| boot: "research/** persists by doctrine" | rule-13 had REFUSED it since 2026-07-23 |
| lookback: searches the corpus | `charters/` — his own twenty entries — was not in it |
| the buffer | exists; no newcomer can discover it |

**Proposed as a standing lens rather than a task:** ask of every surface — *does this ever claim a
state it is not in?* It would have caught all five before they cost anything.

### 6. IT REMEMBERS WELL — recall, lessons, knowledge quality

**Items:** T071 creative-robustness / relevance budget · T094 recall heuristics · T032 retrieval
v2 · T092 reasoning spine · (shipped: T011 recall vNext, T013 lesson forge, T015 credit accrual)

**Status: strong foundation, tuning unfinished.** 646 lessons, 8.9% funnel value. T071's R1
relevance budget is flagged for early unpark — it bears directly on the cost of every boot in the
fleet.

### 7. HOW WE WORK — doctrine and method

**Items:** `ORG.md` **RATIFIED 2026-08-01** · `CONDUCT.md` (law) · `WORKING-METHOD.md` (proposed)
· T031 method-baseline enforcement · T124 interiority capture

**Status: two of three planes settled.** ORG ratified tonight; its Part 7 projection list is the
open work, because a contract is inert until projected into organs that fire.

## The waves

Each wave states what it is *for*, not what it touches. A wave closes when its outcome is true,
not when its tasks are marked done.

### WAVE A — *finish the two things he named* (in flight now)

| | |
|---|---|
| **Outcome** | He can ask "what does this affect" and get a trustworthy answer; and he can seed an idea without babysitting it. |
| **Work** | T125 grading (with `opus-engineer`) → unparks T101, T103, T104. T126 slices S1–S4. |
| **Blocked on** | codex returning to score. Nothing else. |
| **Why first** | Both are his stated priorities, and T125 unblocks three parked tasks behind it. |

### WAVE B — *the fleet stops fighting itself*

| | |
|---|---|
| **Outcome** | No mis-routed, mis-woken, mis-consumed mail. A seat can be spun up or lost without ceremony. |
| **Work** | T108 (live) with T095, T076, T116, T106 unparked alongside it — their park reasons already say *"unpark WITH T108."* |
| **Blocked on** | a fence requiring deepseek + kimi, both currently down. **Bringing those seats up is the unblock.** |
| **Why second** | It is the largest cluster and the most recurring cost; every other wave runs on this substrate. |

### WAVE C — *he can see it*

| | |
|---|---|
| **Outcome** | The engine is legible at a glance — live queue state, both agents thinking, fence state, verdicts landing. |
| **Work** | T033 design-language re-grounding first (T020/T003/T007 are downstream of it), then T079 engine room, then T098 home base. |
| **Why third and not first** | Honest dependency: T079's own framing is the *glass cockpit over the system map*, and T103's navigation surfaces are what it renders. Optics built before navigability would be rebuilt after it. |
| **Caveat, stated plainly** | This is his oldest want. Third is a judgement, not a fact. If he would rather see something beautiful sooner than have it be right, that is a legitimate call and it should be his — say so and this becomes Wave A′. |

### WAVE D — *it remembers well*

T071-R1 relevance budget (early-unpark flagged), then T094, T032, T092. Cheapest measurable win
in the project: R1 caps boot lesson cost for every seat, every session.

### WAVE E — *the doctrine fires by itself*

ORG.md Part 7's six projections — declare the cap, name understudies, fill claude's stretch, add
`pauses:` to lane-open, mechanize the Scribe, institute F1 (Siemens round) and F2 (GO/NO-GO).
Then T031's forcing functions. This wave is what stops the other four from drifting.

## Improvements proposed, not yet asked for

1. **Tag every ledger task with its thread.** One field. Boot then renders work by PURPOSE, and
   "his oldest want is his most neglected" becomes visible automatically instead of requiring a
   synthesis like this one. **This is the durable fix for the problem this document solves by
   hand — and without it, this document rots into another `ROADMAP.md`.**
2. **The truth lens (thread 5) as a ship-gate question**, not a task: does this surface ever claim
   a state it is not in?
3. **Wishlist `Land:` routing is already thread-shaped** — ~113 wishes each name their task.
   Rolling them up per thread would show which thread generates the most felt friction, which is
   a better priority signal than age.
4. **Name `opus-engineer` as Chief of Staff understudy** — ORG.md B3 requires an understudy per
   mind-post, and that post currently records none while claude holds it.

---

## What this plan does NOT do

It does not re-prioritise on its own authority. The waves are a proposal; the threads are a
finding. The one place it takes a position against the obvious reading is Wave C, and it says so
in the open rather than burying it.
